#JUSTIN: Dr Riek Gai Kok’s supporters kicked off his campaign for Governorship outlining his agenda. 
Dr. Riek Gai Kok under the SPLM Party is one whom We feel has the advantage due to his creativity and productivity in developmental sector.  
In all his spheres of working experience, he has been productive and effective. In his duties as A minister of Health, he stood out during his time as national minister, 
  He was also engaged by international agencies such as Unesco and others and he effectively delivered.
Dr Riek Gai Kok is a humanitarian, he has sponsored a lot of students across South Sudan through schools, got jamb forms which he has been doing for over 15years now,  created skill acquisitions and gave start up capital to those who graduated, he has bought laptops to lots of students.  Some of us believe his excellence In every task given to him makes him a round peg in a round hole!  
 Being in the SPLM Party, Dr. Riek Gai Kok has a massive fan base and followership which are more of the youths.  
His slogan is Jonglei Next! 
It stands for the time where the next generation who have always been said to be leaders has come, the future of the youths is no longer tomorrow!  He believes the future of the youths and the next generation is now.  
Further more, Dr Riek Gai Kok encapsulate his dreams and idea in what he termed as the ACEES agenda. 
Which ranges from
  Agriculture 
Critical Infrastructure 
Education
Economic and Gender empowerment and
Security.  
His ideas are different and an idea which deals with practical approaches to different sectors of the ACEES Agenda.
Briefly, Agriculture has to do with going into mechanized agriculture and the use of improve seedlings, creating markets for farmers and getting our fertilizer plants ready for massive production to alleviate sufferings for farmers.
Critical Infrastructure has to do with a lot but before then it has to do with sinking opportunities into the Economy and the taxed gotten from the economy will be shifted and used for capital projects which has direct impact on the common man. 
 He also spoke about setting Aside whatever is gotten for the youths, physically challenged,  women and people who are not bouyant for them to access capitals for start ups and this are zero interest loans. 
   Permit me to be joining Critical infrastructure and Economy together as I fee the both work hand in hand. So if we have a blooming economy,  we shall have enough taxes we can use to undergo a lot of projects for the state. 
Education is a bedrock of a thriving society and he spoke haven been a promoter of education and being in the system to create avenues in which educational sector will receive rapid and much attention via creation of classrooms, providing equipments that aids learning and also the most important of them all stimulating the teachers via prompt payment of their entitlement as he believes a worker who is entitled to his wages will do well and better if he is motivated. 
Finally,  he spoke deeply about security. And he has the ideas of massive recruitment of hunters and the use of Operation Rainbow in our various communities as the first point of security. the use of laser glasses at night and the use of security drones and other training to enable the security of people on the Jonglei State. 
Dr. Riek Gai Kok also believe security can thrive more when the two parties believe, agree and trust each other as such he has talks of plans where all parties will be brought together in different fora and platforms to discuss practical approach to peaceful coexistence.  
Finally, Dr. Riek Gai Kok has gone to virtually the whole wards on the Jonglei State and as such has seen the peculiar problems each community he has gone to has and I am verily certain he will take efforts to bringing succor to the common Jonglei People. 
Riek Gai Kok is a way forward!  Riek Gai Kok will deliver!
Cde Manath Gany. See less

#JUSTIN: Puot Kang Corrupts JOCs Deployment Processes as SPLM-IO Aims to Dominate South Sudan’s Oil Corporation - Nilepet.
By Geng Makec Thonlei.
News reaching our desk have keenly established that the highly overrated, corrupt and rebellious minister of petroleum seeks to extend SPLM-IO’s dominance over South Sudan’s oil and gas industry even further. This comes after long-standing years of politicized oil production policies, corruption in procurement practices, sabotage, and distortions of oil and gas policies within Ministry of Petroleum ever since Mr. Puot Kang was appointed in February 2020. Ultimately, these combined to cripple oil production to its current stasis or erosion. 
“Since then, the oil & gas sector, critical to South Sudan’s economic recovery post-conflict was extremely jeopardized and degenerated into a total chaos” -sources privy to the matter suggest. “Instead of the oil and gas sector becoming the key cornerstone in revitalizing rapid, inclusive economic recovery, they continued, a reverse which is -oil being a potential trigger of renewed civil war in South Sudan, has been fostered and encouraged by the current minister of petroleum, Mr. Puot Kang”. 
To add salt to injury, concerned sources within the power centers stressed, Mr. Puot Kang has not stopped at messing the Ministry of Petroleum only. Through Puot Kang’s resolve in furthering SPLM-IO’s dominance over the oil and gas sector, a close confidante of the superbly rich Petroleum minister has revealed that he (Puot) has secured numerous positions in JOCs for his close relatives, former rebels, and active members of SPLM-IO in the upcoming reshuffling by the Nilepet MD.  
Mr. Puot Kang’s confidante elaborated further that earlier last week after euphoric celebrations at Gabat in what was dubbed “Celebration of 100 days of Nilepet Transformation under Nilepet MD -Hon Bernard Amour Makeny”, a deal was struck between Minister Puot Kang & MD Bernard Amour to allocate several lucrative top managerial positions for Puot Kang & his rebellious outfit, SPLM-IO, across the three main JOCs (GPOC, SPOC). This include but not limited to Vice Presidency of SPOC, Procurement for GPOC, General Service for SPOC, and several other positions. 
Admittedly, Puot Kang’s confidante emphasized further saying that active SPLM-IO members have already been enlisted in the approved list of  Nilepet deployment to the JOCS due to be released by Monday May 29th 2023. By this, he sternly acknowledges, the Nilepet Co.LTD and JOCs in entirety will have come under heavy infiltrations, secretly maximizing SPLM-IO’s extensive influence over Nilepet & JOCs.
With due considerations to Dar Petroleum, Mr.Puot Kang’s close confidante revealed that Minister Puot Kang and his close circles aim to exploit Nilepet MD even more. He confided that the Nilepet MD was mis-advised to make deployments to DPOC after changes to SPOC & GPOC have been finalized. And that the reason behind such scammed advice is that Minister Puot Kang and his SPLM-IO circles have secretly plotted to sabotage DPOC secondments thereafter in order to intimidate Nilepet MD Bernard Amour Makeny to also accept sharing of top managerial positions in DPOC with SPLM-IO nominees. He furthered that once SPOC & GPOC deployments are completed by Monday, separately, minus DPOC secondments being simultaneously deployed, the SPLM-IO’s planned capture of Nilepet Corporation & JOCs will have been a complete success. 
Whereas Nilepet Corporation has seen series of much-hyped transformation slogans in most recent months, the transformation project under MD Bernard Amour Makeny looks set to be fueling war-profiteering logic post-conflict, corruption and associated dominance over oil and gas sector for the SPLM-IO respectively.
 In nutshells, as Bernard Amour strives to fundamentally transform the tattered corporation from years-long mismanagement & lack of transparency in its operations, he should be extremely wary of ongoing capture of JOCs & Nilepet by Mr. Puot Kang & his corrupt SPLM-IO syndicates -analysts caution!
 As a matter of fact, checking against such potential capture of JOCs by the SPLM-IO will mean not falling for delays in JOCs deployments through Mr.Puot Kang’s calculated moves to constantly sabotage these changes to happen in order to create leverages for him to smuggle through overly inexperienced, technically semi-illiterate, and resource-thirsty, active SPLM-IO members to key technical and managerial positions in the JOCs. 
Notably, as the MD plans to introduce changes in the JOCs by Monday 29th 2023 or sooner than later, Hon. Bernard Amour Makeny should ensure simultaneous deployments to SPOC, GPOC, and DPOC as well. This will stop any further compromises in the DPOC deployment process as clearly illustrated by the cases of SPOC & GPOC secondment lists which have been heavily compromised by Mr. Puot Kang by capturing key technical positions for the SPLM-IO and his immediate relatives. Short of that, President Salva Kiir will only continue to lose confidence in working with Mr. Puot Kang and Bernard Amour Makeny as close sources privy to J1 have been suggestive of president’s emerging distrust and disinterest in the two oil officials. #JUSTIN: The press Secretary in the office of the Chairman of the South Sudan People's Movement/Army condemns the indiscriminate shooting of innocent civilians by Gen. Makal Kuol of SSPDF. 
Commissioner of Mayom County John Bol Mayak and Major General Makal Kuol moved from Mayom to Mankien through Abiemnom and Akotong roads on 26/5/2023. They found three unarmed civilians on the border of Twic and Mayom on their way to Bieh Payam from Ajak Kuac where they went to sell their cows. 
The commissioner and General Makal Kuol got out of their vehicles and started firing at innocent civilians. Thank God, none of the civilians was injured. The civilians ran back to Ajak Kuac Payam and reported the incident to Ajak Kuac authority and the nearby SSPDF division-3 barrack.
Today We were surprised by a statement issued by the office of the commissioner of Mayom County that they were ambushed by the
SSPA on their way to Mankien. The question is how could the SSPA ambush them in the territory of Twic, Warrap state where there is no presence of the SSPA?
The commissioner is just creating a situation by covering up the shooting of innocent civilians and that he is not happy with the presence of a huge number of Mayom County civilians in Ajak Kuac, Twic, Warrap state who fled to Ajak Kuac in 2021, because of intimidation and mistreatment of civilians in Mayom county. The SSPM/A is warning the commissioner of Mayom County that the
SSPA can attack him at his HQ in the territory of Mayom County and not in the territory of Warrap state as he has falsely stated.
Cde Luke Gattiek Gai. 
Press Secretary Chairman’s office.
Dajo, Upper Nile Region. See less

#BREAKING NEWS: Far-reaching loggerhead erupted on Friday in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs few days after President Salva Kiir gave the Acting Minister of Foreign Affairs Hon. Deng Dau a green light to curb the rampant corruption crippling the Ministry. 
News emerging from the Ministry of foreign affairs indicates that there is a fierce fight ongoing between the Acting Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Hon. Deng Dau Deng, and the Undersecretary of the Ministry, Ambassador Mayen Dut Wol over administrative changes to address the issue of corruption in the Ministry. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has been ailing from systemic corruption practices that involve the Department of Finance under the direct supervision of the Undersecretary of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. This has consistently been reported, and there is growing frustration among the diplomats over the inability of the leadership of the ministry to resolve this issue. 
The Department of Finance, under the leadership of Ambassador Mayen Dut, has been spearheading massive corruption in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. There are reports of diplomats' salaries disappearing now and then, rent of embassies diverted after being released by the Ministry of Finance and Planning, and recycling of financial claims that the Ministry of Finance has already paid. All these are presided upon by Ambassador Mayen Dut and his director of Finance, Ambassador Mun Deng Ajuet. 
However; with the growing number of complaints from within the Ministry and Missions abroad, the Acting Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation directed an internal reshuffle of the Department of Finance; replacing the Director of Finance, Controller of Accounts, Cashiers, and other junior staff. This instantly caused profound discontent from Undersecretary Mayen Dut, and the two are currently at loggerheads. Ambassador Mayen does not want his cronies, who have been the Centre of corruption in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, replaced. These guys have been consistently milking the ministry at the expense of severe South Sudanese diplomats, both in the church and in the mission abroad. As we speak, the salaries and rental arrears of the Diplomatic Missions of the Republic of South Sudan have surpassed the $150 Million mark. The Ministry of Finance has been paying by installment. However, still, the figure keeps shooting up just because Ambassador Mayen Dut and his financial criminals have been doctoring the financial records of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs since 2019.
His Excellency, the President of the Republic, directed the Acting Minister of Foreign Affairs to reorganize and address issues regarding the financial administration of the Ministry. Still, now the Undersecretary, who is, in fact, a severe financial criminal, is seriously sabotaging the directives of the President. For this week, the two gentlemen have been fighting over the reshuffle initiated by the Acting Minister. The Undersecretary is vehemently resisting these changes since this will seal off the corrupt practices from which he has benefited immensely. As of now, Ambassador Mayen traveled to Wau to consult his spiritual advisors/witch doctors (Magician/Juju) from Luo and Fartit, based in Wau. He met one of these magicians upon his arrival, and he is meeting another tomorrow, intending to ensure that the directives issued by the Acting Minister are sabotaged.
On the other hand, the other hand related report in connection:
Grapevine Report: 
For Your Eyes Only of SPLM Comrades Nation Wide
The undersecretary of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation has traveled to Wau for Juju consultations with prominent witchcraft spearheads in Wau, Western Bahar Ghazal, according to an inbox message from a reliable source.
In Wau, an informed source reports that the undersecretary has been staying at one of the well-known hotels owned by a prominent businessman. 
This visit is intended to quell the acting minister of his institution from the recent directives that aimed to eliminate the corruption nest in the finance department. After he merged into the Khartoum local government and the South Sudanese government in 2005 after CPA, he has been kept in government institutions as a result of his witchcraft practice. 
In Wau, he carried a briefcase containing 200 000 USD, which he disturbed for witchcraft activities.
Having knowledge of his activities, it is surprising that he always insists that he has been backed by someone close to the president in the government; further investigation reveals that these claims are unsubstantiated and untrue.
The information that the said individual was on a short vacation for witchcraft purposes in Wau has been circulating for several days.

#JUSTIN:TONJ YOUTH DEMANDS THE REMOVAL OF MR. MADING  ALEU AND DR. BENJAMIN BANG BANG FROM THE TEAM SELECTED TO ORGANIZE PRESIDENT KIIR NOMINATION CELEBRATION. 
Inclusion of Tong Mading Aleu and Dr. Benjamin Bang Bang in a committee of President Kiir's Celebration will prove Gen. Akol Koor Kuc is their godfather behind their massive criminal activities everywhere
Akol Koor’s greedy boys made a thick propaganda recently that leader Gregory Vassilis is busy doing dirty political works against Governor Manhiem Bol but Gen. Gregory can not do that to his trusted brother Manhiem. The truth has been found this week. It is confirmed in a leaked private separate conversation between some people who directly communicated with former Tonj Youth Union leader Tong Mading Aleu and other people who talked with Dr. Benjamin Bang Bang have now revealed that Gen. Akol Koor Kuc and Gen. Manyang Manhom Awan have threatened Governor Manhiem Bol Malek and warned that it is a redline to remove Tong Mading Aleu and Dr. Benjamin Bang Bang in the organising committee which is tasked by a political businessman Athuai Athuai Achuil to conduct a celebration of President Kiir's nomination as SPLM flagbearer.
In fact, the meeting between President Kiir and these controversial Youths was planned by Gen. Akol Koor and Gen. Manyang Manhom Awan weeks before it happened. There was no way they can make it to meet President Kiir without the help of a powerful Gen. Manyang Manhom. If anyone doubts let any other Tonj sons and daughters who do not belong to what Gen. Akol Koor call his camp try to approach Gen. Manyang with the aim to meet the President or even Executive Director in President's office and see what happened next. A simple example, why would Governor Manhiem sought the help of other significance to President Kiir to meet him the President when Gen. Manyang Manhom is there and he did not speed up or facilitate meetings between Governor and the President. This is simply because Gen. Manyang was part of the scheme to block Governor Manhiem after successfully causing the confusion and tie it on his neck (Manhiem). It has happened in numerous occasions when any Tonj son and daughter is fired by President Kiir, it happens a prime celebration is always in the presence of Gen. Akol Koor and Gen. Manyang. 
In a private meeting, Gen. Akol and Gen. Manyang made it clear that Tong Mading Aleu and Dr. Benjamin Bang Bang should head the committee responsible for the Presidential Celebration scheduled to take place on 30th May 2023. As it is now the case and clear that a leader of Blue House is facilitating these well-known criminals, there will be a non-stop wage of all-out war against Gen. Akol Koor, Gen. Manyang Manhom and their beloved boys Tong and Bang.
Before a war started on the Blue House leader and his said associates, this scheduled celebration for 30th May will be monitored until it takes place first in order to confirm the participation of Tong and Bang in the organising committee. Why is it important to make sure Tong Mading and Benjamin Bang are not going to be part of the organising committee by Gen. Akol Koor and Gen. Manyang Manhom? They have to be honest in the tactical ways they are planning to build and empower young people politically and economically in Tonj and this activity of the Presidential celebration is one which they are including in their grand strategy. They should not be secretly empowering some young people while undermining the ability of other youths. Gen.
